entities.summary: Yusmeiro Alberto Petit is a Venezuelan former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Florida Marlins, Arizona Diamondbacks, San Francisco Giants, Washington Nationals, Los Angeles Angels, and Oakland Athletics. In 2014, Petit retired 46 consecutive batters to set a new MLB record.
